propositions.text: LPB acquired 171 apartments in the controlled 2008 perimeter
LPB sold 12 of the original 171 apartments: 6 in 2009, 4 in 2010 and 2 in 2011; contemporaneous ledgers record €1,029,000 gross sale value
propositions.limit: two 2011 deeds individually reviewed; earlier ten remain to be deed-by-deed provenance-bound

propositions.text: the 12 sold units were within LPB's original 171-apartment perimeter; the second mortgage covered 161 fincas after the first ten sales and Bankia's execution covered 159 after the final two
sale proceeds were used in material part to reduce bank debt, but not every gross-sale euro was allocated to principal or arrears
the two 2011 post-origination sales reduced the €850k mortgage by €5,279.50 each; €850,000 - €10,559 = €839,441, exactly Bankia's accelerated principal
the €839,441 principal component is reconciled to the two post-origination releases; the interest/default-interest components and notice/liquidation mechanics remain open
Bankia liquidation showed €0 capital arrears before acceleration
€405,000 pledged funds cured or could have prevented default
swap and financing were economically integrated
swap and mortgage were legally inseparable
enforcement/auction was causally material to voluntary concurso

Bankia's pleading description of unpaid capital amortisation from July 2011 is inconsistent with the deed: first capital amortisation was due 1-Jan-2012; Bankia's own liquidation shows €0 matured unpaid capital
LPB's ledger and Bankia's liquidation support unpaid/catch-up interest maturities from summer 2011; exact interest arithmetic remains to be reconciled

the 12 apartment sales do not on current evidence extinguish Bankia's basic entitlement to commence enforcement of the €850k mortgage; entitlement turns on unpaid interest, valid registered acceleration, notice/liquidation and separate creditor succession

CaixaBank's PKF Annex IX models €850k principal through 2011 and does not incorporate the two extraordinary €5,279.50 releases reflected in Bankia's actual 2011 liquidation; it should not be treated as the historical principal ledger without reconciliation
